content_text: [1/5 @enjeeneer] Introducing Scout 🧭 A forecasting agent post-trained from Inkling 2 Small that is as accurate as Fable 5.2 (medium) at 1/15th the cost. We use Scout to generate 100k revenue and EPS forecasts for every S&P 500 company for 2027, under 50 geopolitical and economic scenarios. All of this and more in our @thinkymachines blog post and demo! 🧵 --- [2/5 @enjeeneer] The best AI forecasters are now as good as pro human forecasters, but they're expensive to run. We could unlock radical new use cases if we could run these cheaply, at scale. Scout 🧭 is a step in this direction: it extends the cost-accuracy frontier. --- [3/5 @enjeeneer] Research, modeling, analysis and prediction are all trained end-to-end with RL. Interesting/smart forecasting behaviors emerge through training. E.g. Scout learns to write probabilistic simulations and backtest them on historical data pulled from our databases. The share of questions that get a base rate calc goes from 37% -> 92% etc. --- [4/5 @enjeeneer] Part of the recipe is a reward that reduces noise. A single outcome is a noisy signal of forecast quality, so we mix the outcome log score with the expected log score under a reference forecast from an ensemble of strong models. It works out to an outcome reward plus a KL penalty to the reference. --- [5/5 @enjeeneer] Work with cracked @hanshalgoyal, supported by the wider @_Mantic_AI team. - Blog post: https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/training-a-scalable-forecasting-agent/ - Demo: https://mantic.com/100k-forecasts
